behaviors.description: Continuous high/low cosine tide retains the Cardinal period/phase and world-clock resynchronization. Physical water remains continuous; no cell activation, remeshing ownership or block relocation is inherited.
behaviors.selection: Invoked by the tracked WaterSystem application and its presentation/query consumers.

checks.expectation: Continuous high/low cosine tide retains the Cardinal period/phase and world-clock resynchronization. Physical water remains continuous; no cell activation, remeshing ownership or block relocation is inherited.
checks.procedure: Check high/low ordering, period/phase, rising/falling, pause/resume and integral-clock resync; compare numeric samples to the legacy cosine equation.
